time_independent_variable: same positive absolute finite time; not a resource optimum or normalized baseline
state_family: same frozen CISD from HF-reference plus single/double determinant excitation subspace

time_contract.equality: binary64 hex equality; no tolerance, nearest or interpolation
time_contract.selection_rule: If all prerequisites and >=3 valid common times: smallest positive, median, largest; inspect invalidity metadata only.
time_contract.median_for_even_cardinality: unresolved_requires_review; do not invent a midpoint outside intersection
time_contract.known_invalid_largest: stop common_time_contract_requires_review; do not silently drop or replace it
time_contract.source_oracle_fit_times: catalog only; not predictor scales or synthesized candidates

freeze_boundary: P1: all selected coordinates cheap acquisition without truth
P2: all selected coordinates M1 acquisition without truth; no routing
scorer-only exact-coordinate truth read after blob identity verification
blocked_status_precedence: missing state or incompatible fixed M1 contract outranks time-grid review; both blockers preserved
mechanism_label_policy: descriptive multi-label candidate interpretations only; no new effect threshold, causality, scaling exponent or asymptotic claim; no labels assigned in preflight
prohibited: new state/H/proxy/M1/direct/scorer computation without separate approval
